recognize_zh: 中央一顆巨大原紅血球，核圓大、染色質細緻偏紅紫，細胞質為深藍色，邊緣向外伸出兩個鈍圓突起，像狗耳朵（dog ears）；旁邊有正常顆粒球與小淋巴球可比較大小，在紅系再生不良中提示 parvovirus B19 感染。
features: Giant proerythroblast much larger than adjacent granulocytes and lymphocyte
Large round nucleus with finely granular, reddish-purple chromatin and small pink nuclear granules
Intensely basophilic cytoplasm forming a rim around the nucleus
Two blunt, deeply basophilic cytoplasmic projections (pseudopodia resembling dog ears)
Neighboring metamyelocyte/band neutrophil with fine granules and a small lymphocyte
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant proerythroblast with a large round nucleus, finely granular reddish-purple chromatin and a rim of intensely basophilic cytoplasm. The cytoplasm forms two blunt, dark blue pseudopod-like projections resembling dog ears. Adjacent granulocytic precursors and a small lymphocyte provide size comparison. Giant proerythroblasts with such cytoplasmic projections in an erythroid-depleted marrow are characteristic of parvovirus B19 infection and should be confirmed by PCR or immunohistochemistry. Findings are consistent with a giant proerythroblast with cytoplasmic pseudopodia in pure red cell aplasia.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts also show cytoplasmic blebs but have less intensely blue cytoplasm, may bud platelets and are CD41/CD61-positive rather than glycophorin/E-cadherin-positive.
Normal proerythroblasts are smaller, occur with a full maturing erythroid series and lack intranuclear inclusions or giant size.
AML blasts form an increased population with granules or Auer rods and myeloid markers, not isolated giant erythroid precursors.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and express CD138, lacking dog-ear cytoplasmic projections.
